messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

    earlier: Farah is on the Team Dune on-call rotation; as of 2026-02-04 the pager for this cycle is carried by Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2026-02-04 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-15, Farah is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation, carrying the pager for this cycle. [valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-02-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-27, Tomasz Nowak is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation, carrying the pager for this cycle. [valid 2025-10-27 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-22, Tomasz Nowak is off the Team Dune on-call rotation, after holding the pager since 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-09-22 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-22]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz Nowak is on call for Team Dune this cycle, having received the pager from Farah. [valid 2025-07-30 to 2025-09-22; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, Farah is on call for Team Dune this cycle. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-17]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- On 2025-03-17, Tomasz Nowak wrote the handover document for the billing service handover for Marcus. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
